mapper.select: SELECT cr.id, cr.resource_name AS name, IFNULL(rt.name, '文档') AS type, 0 AS size, DATE_FORMAT(cr.created_time, '%Y-%m-%dT%H:%i:%sZ') AS uploadDate, 0 AS downloadCount, cr.resource_url AS url FROM course_resource cr LEFT JOIN resource_type rt ON cr.type_id = rt.id WHERE cr.course_id = #{courseId} ORDER BY cr.created_time DESC

SELECT cr.id, cr.resource_name AS name, cr.chapter_id AS chapterId, cc.title AS chapterName, IFNULL(cr.duration, 0) AS duration, 0 AS playCount, cr.sort_order AS order FROM course_resource cr LEFT JOIN course_chapter cc ON cr.chapter_id = cc.id WHERE cr.course_id = #{courseId} AND cr.type_id = 1 ORDER BY cr.chapter_id, cr.sort_order
SELECT cr.resource_url AS url, IFNULL(cr.duration, 0) AS duration, '1080p' AS quality FROM course_resource cr WHERE cr.id = #{videoId} AND cr.type_id = 1
